name: gooey-dropdown
title: Gooey Dropdown
description: A compact Share button that opens into a menu through a liquid goo effect. The pill's rounded shape stretches into a larger panel listing actions, and clicking one or outside closes it.
use: A compact Share action needs a small menu that opens with a distinctive liquid motion.
avoid: The menu needs many items or nested submenus; the panel is a flat list with no scrolling.
a11y: Trigger and items are buttons with menu roles and Escape, but there is no arrow-key focus handling or reduced-motion path. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale rounded Share pill on a dark stage. Open, it becomes a larger off-white rounded panel with four grey menu rows, joined to the pill by a curved neck; a row highlights when hovered.
behaves: Clicking the pill runs a spring that stretches a gooey bridge downward as the menu grows, revealing item rows. Picking an item or clicking outside springs the whole shape back to the pill.
customise: Set trigger text, the items array with per-item clicks, width, alignment, gaps, radii, fill colour, goo strength and spring. The layout below the button is fixed.
weight: light: A single animated clip path and one SVG goo filter; no loop runs.
